name: Synapse
author: Lwb89dev
description: Control your terminal AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Grok) from an Android phone. Bar widget with live sessions, a "needs you" badge and a pairing QR; the backend and the Android app live in the same repository.

barWidget.description: Agent sessions reachable from your phone, with a badge when one needs input; pair a phone with a QR code.
